title: htmx and server-rendered HTML
description: Conventions for htmx and server-rendered HTML.

rules.title: Return HTML fragments
rules.text: Return HTML fragments from the server and let htmx swap them; avoid client-side rendering logic.

rules.title: Progressive enhancement
rules.text: Make pages work without JavaScript where feasible and enhance with htmx attributes.

rules.title: CSRF headers
rules.text: Send CSRF tokens on htmx requests via hx-headers.

rules.title: Explicit targets
rules.text: Set explicit hx-target and hx-swap so responses land predictably.
